verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a GPU cloud marketplace, but the evidence never shows a deployable, self-hostable version of the Vast.ai platform. The 'Host GPUs and earn' program lists your own machines as a provider on Vast's hosted marketplace, which is a different capability. The open-source vast-cli on GitHub is only a client for the hosted service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
